title: FRSC 4730H - Advanced Topics in Forensic Chemistry
text: Welcome to the FRSC 4730H course backend webpage. These are the presentations we use for lecture. Most lectures will have additional demonstrations/visuals that are displayed outside of the main “slide deck”.

title: FRSC 4730H - Advanced Topics in Forensic Chemistry
text:
Lectures

1: Course admin + Review of forensic chemistry
2: What is a measurement
3: Emerging analytical technicques in forensic chemistry
4: Emerging Applications of chemistry in forensic science
5: An introduction to (or refresher on) programming in R
6: Similarities and differences
7: Projections and dimensionality reduction
8: Representing chemical structure
9: A numerical exploration of molecular space
